reasons: At least two active, human-reviewed labels are required; do not activate provisional labels automatically.
No real temporal samples are available.
At least three participants are required for a nonempty signer-independent three-way split. Collect more signers; consider leave-one-signer-out later.

statistics.metricScope: Structurally valid, non-rejected, unique samples only; total/rejected include all inputs.

export: blocked until real selection and evaluation

normalizationState.note: No dataset means/std are fitted; each clip uses its own shared geometric origin/scale.

geometric.origin: mean wrist xyz of reliably assigned hands in first valid frame
geometric.scale: maximum absolute coordinate relative to this shared origin across every assigned point in the complete clip
geometric.depthLimit: MediaPipe z is wrist-relative per hand, not calibrated inter-hand depth

inferenceContract.missing: zero coordinates plus per-hand 0 mask; all-zero rows are masked by the RNN
inferenceContract.resampling: inclusive linspace(0,durationMs,T), linear between adjacent valid observations only; gaps beyond configured limit and outside observed range are zero/masked; duplicate or unordered timestamps rejected
inferenceContract.handedness: Day-4 fixed physical slots: raw Right -> left, raw Left -> right for unmirrored pixels; confidence >=0.8; unassigned observations are not imputed
inferenceContract.mirroring: no coordinate flips; CSS preview only

output.interpretation: uncalibrated relative class probabilities, not proof of correctness; no meeting acceptance threshold selected
